interventionPairs.claim: the elimination does not depend on the intervention; the intervention is required only to have a (pass, unit) to attribute the elimination TO

readingWithoutIntervention.why: the subject still has a unit of its own (state PRESENT): at this optimisation level the intervention was not what made the attribution possible, which contradicts the pair's expectation and is a result in its own right.

absorbedFill.why: 32B of zero fill where the source asks for two 32B wipes: one of them is gone. Byte counting cannot say WHICH, so this is consistent with the subject's store having been removed and is not on its own proof of it.

verdict.why: the subject kept a unit of its own without the intervention, so at this level the intervention was not what made the attribution possible. The claim's second half is contradicted here; its first half is untouched.

fullResult.why: the whole result is a lab artefact; the pair is what this file keeps. See README.md for the command.
